# Spacedock

> Your agents are waiting on you. Spacedock brings you the calls that need you, keeps your agents on the goal, and lets you decide in one place.

Documentation for Spacedock, which runs inside your existing coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, or Pi) and has three features. Spacedock Review puts your agent's work in front of you and sends your comments back. Spacedock Compass shows whether your agents are still on the goal. Spacedock Workflow breaks work into stages and surfaces an evidenced decision at each gate. This index links the product docs; llms-full.txt is every page concatenated into one file for a single fetch.
